title: Price-led choice
idea: Price-led choice: A clear offer and editable quantity share the opening field with a complete cost summary.
audience: People who need to review price within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Price and inclusions are the main unresolved buying questions.
avoidWhen: Recurring charges or eligibility terms are unknown.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its review price priority and explicit commitment contract: Show current server-controlled price, cadence and required terms before checkout.
navigation: Price-led choice keeps the current review price context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A clear offer and editable quantity share the opening field with a complete cost summary.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review price; price and inclusions are the main unresolved buying questions.
composition.priority: Show current server-controlled price, cadence and required terms before checkout.

imagery.role: Support the actual review price context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep inclusion details readable before the purchase action; do not pin a bar over terms.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the price-led choice structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review price content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Show current server-controlled price, cadence and required terms before checkout.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review price content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Show current server-controlled price, cadence and required terms before checkout.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review price context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
